This run is deliberately single-vendor: architect, workers, auditors and this final gate are one model family, so a chain of PASS results here is not independent review, and no cross-vendor gate over any stage's work exists in this system.

No output event of the opencode CLI names the model that produced a stage, MODEL_MISMATCH is therefore unverifiable, and every execution.model line - this result's included - is the stage's own report of itself, confirmed by nothing else.

The opencode permission map closed raw sources and frozen machinery to edit tools but not to shell commands, whose globs match command text and not paths; a raw write would have been caught by the control lock on the next runner command, after the fact, not prevented.

The audit_spec release rule 'no business number literal may appear in a generator' has no declared check over src/release/build_release.py (figures_not_hardcoded covers src/analysis only) and src/ is outside my inputs, so generator-literal compliance is unverified in this run.

Carry schema conformance is unverifiable from my inputs: audit/schemas/carry.schema.json is outside them, and the carries carry a next_stage_hints field beyond the field list the general contract names for a carry.
